title: Cisco security advisory (AV26-1042)
description: As of October 14, 2026, Cisco is affected by a vulnerability in the following products:
products:
Cisco AsyncOS Software for Cisco Secure Email Gateway Release
	15.5 version prior to 15.5.5-014
16.5 versions prior to 16.5.0-780

Cisco Secure Email and Web Manager Release
	15.5 version prior to 15.5.5-006
16.5 versions prior to 16.5.0-429
solution: Review the references and apply the necessary updates.
